channel.title: Alabama Political Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama Political Reporter (alreporter.com)

item.title: Alabama Young Farmers recognized for outstanding achievements
item.description: Lawrence County’s Drew Wear and Autauga County’s Drew and Lauren Wendland were among those honored as competitive young farmer contests closed.

item.title: Sen. Bernie Moreno endorses Barry Moore in Alabama Senate race
item.description: Moreno threw his support behind Moore in the Alabama Senate race, calling him an “America First warrior.”

item.title: University of Alabama System announces 2026 class of Capitol Scholars
item.description: The UA System selected 18 students for the 2026 Capitol Scholars, who will pursue immersive summer internships and learning opportunities in Washington D.C.

item.title: Prison reform advocate’s wife speaks out after hunger strike surpasses three weeks
item.description: Dr. Elizabeth Traywick described the "silent torture" of watching her husband starve while state officials provided vague or nonexistent communication about his condition.

item.title: UA defends magazine closures as free speech group weighs further involvement
item.description: The free speech organization strongly condemned the University of Alabama's decision, arguing the closures violated the First Amendment and editorial independence.

item.title: Fannie Mae will be moving San Francisco offices to Birmingham, Sen. Tuberville announces
item.description: Tuberville portrayed Fannie Mae’s decision as the mortgage financier “leaving woke California for sweet home Alabama.”

item.title: Opinion | Alabama’s death machinery is now driven by politics, not justice
item.description: Alabama’s attorney general pushes extreme execution methods and narrow legal arguments, testing constitutional limits and abandoning the restraint our founders expected.

item.title: Opinion | Medical cannabis could soon find its way to Alabama patients
item.description: Medical cannabis is about to start flowing to Alabama patients, because the AMCC finally decided to follow the law.

item.title: Sen. Chris Elliott brings back Archives takeover bill
item.description: The bill, which nearly passed last year, would give politicians greater control over the Department of Archives and History.

item.title: TROY offers new pathway to nursing careers with Accelerated Master of Science in Nursing track
item.description: Troy University launched an Accelerated MSN track, expanding access for those with non-nursing degrees to meet Alabama’s healthcare needs.
